messages:
elena (docs): Heads-up: in the /v1/generate API ref the `response_type` enum lists `FULL` and `PARTIAL` (UPPERCASE) but our quickstart and examples consistently send `full` lowercase. A customer hit a 400 when following the quickstart. I opened a docs PR to reconcile examples and add guidance: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8930

noah (runtime): Can you paste the failing request body from the customer? I want to confirm runtime behavior before we change docs.

elena (docs): Sure, from their curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hey","response_type":"full"}'
```
They got: `{"code":400, "message":"invalid enum value for response_type"}`.

linkbot: docs-bot: PR opened by elena 1 docs reviewers requested: tia, aj 1 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8930

tia (devex): Noted another inconsistency: the API ref error example shows `{\"message\": \"...\"}` but our Node/TS SDK unwraps `error.message` (`{error:{message:"..."}}`). We should either standardize or document both shapes.

aj (sdk): On the SDK side I can make clients resilient to both shapes (check resp.error?.message || resp.message). But docs should be clear. My preference: docs present the canonical server shape (keep `{error:{message:...}}`) and then show a compatibility flat `message` example with a deprecation note.

elena (docs): Proposed plan in PR 8930: 1) Change the example request payloads to use `full` (lowercase) as the canonical example; 2) Add a short compatibility note: "server accepts `full` or `FULL`; examples use lowercase"; 3) For error responses, show the canonical wrapper `{\"error\":{\"message\":...}}` and a short deprecated flat example. PTAL.

noah (runtime): I'll add a tiny change in runtime to accept enums case-insensitively and normalize to lowercase internally. Opening runtime PR 612 now. Won't change external behavior, just broaden accepted values. Will include unit test.

tia (devex): Also update the Go example where we demonstrate setting ResponseType.FULL (it currently only shows the const). Add a one-line comment: `// accepted variants: "full" or "FULL"`.

aj (sdk): Will add a compatibility check in Python and JS SDKs so both `full` and `FULL` are accepted by the client helper. I'll include unit tests and update the example links in the docs to point to the updated snippet.

elena (docs): CI ran on PR 8930: docs-lint passed but link-check failed because the python snippet URL referenced an old path. I updated the snippet permalink in the PR to the new location under /snippets/python/generate.md.

linkbot: ci-bot: link-check re-run 1 failures: none. docs-lint: passed.

noah (runtime): Runtime PR 612 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/612. Local tests + unit tests green. Waiting on CI. This will accept case-insensitive enum values and return the canonical internal enum as lowercase.

tia (devex): Quick follow-up: please add a short line in the migration notes (docs/changelog.md) under "Docs" saying: "/v1/generate examples now use lowercase `response_type` in examples; runtime accepts either form."

aj (sdk): SDK PRs for python and js are green. I added comments in the examples and a small test file `tests/test_response_type_variants.py`.

elena (docs): Thanks — once runtime PR 612 merges I'll merge docs PR 8930 so examples reflect live behavior. Targeting merge after runtime CI completes. Will add a tiny changelog bullet as tia requested. :sparkles:
